pages.text:
A failure without a sealed containment releases Fallout: radioactive ash that settles like snow over the chunks round the reactor, in layers at different heights. Every minute some of each contaminated chunk's fallout spreads to the chunks round it, most downwind, and Corium or Solidified Corium left in the open seeps more into the ground. Contaminated chunks glow with green motes in the air, thicker the worse they are, and ash falls where it's heavy.
The dose is full under open sky and a tenth under a roof. Contamination decays over in-game days: most within a few days, a long-lived share over a month, and the ash weathers away with it.

# Contamination
Walking through contaminated ground or air contaminates you and what you hold; a hazmat suit takes most of it.
# Decontamination Shower
Mounted overhead, it washes players under it (two blocks below) and what they carry, using water and wearing out its HEPA Filter. Used filters are low-level waste.
